title: helm(private): validate values schema, add init-hook tolerations and rollback cleanup
author: Priya Nair
description: This PR tightens the values schema for the redwood-private Helm chart, stabilizes init hook behavior during upgrades by adding tolerations and affinity options, and adds a rollback cleanup hook to ensure leftover init artifacts do not block subsequent upgrades. Motivation: customers running on noisy on-prem clusters saw init jobs get evicted during upgrades which caused helm upgrade to hang and left stale configmaps and CRs that prevented automatic rollbacks. The change introduces a JSON Schema for values.yaml that validates common misconfigurations (KMS fields, storage classes, initHook.enabled permutations), exposes helm templating knobs for initJob tolerations and nodeAffinity, and adds a post-rollback Job hook that removes init-stage ConfigMaps/CRs safely. The PR includes unit tests for template rendering, a small integration script that exercises upgrade->rollback->upgrade flows in CI, documentation updates to the chart README describing the new values, and release notes. See linked Linear tickets for rollout and observability follow-ups.
commits: validate(values): add JSON schema and stricter required fields
helm(chart): add tolerations/nodeAffinity to init job template and expose values
hook(rollback): add post-rollback cleanup job and idempotent deletion logic
tests: add template render unit tests and upgrade/rollback integration script
docs: update chart README and values reference
review_comments: Evan Liu (2026-02-17): Can we make tolerations optional and default to the chart-level tolerations? I don't want to force tenants to accept tainted nodes. Reply: Priya Nair: Made tolerations optional and fallback to .Values.tolerations when initJob.tolerations is nil.

Marco D'Angelo (2026-02-18): The post-rollback job looks good but add an ownerReference check so CRs created by other controllers are not deleted. Reply: Priya Nair: Added a namespace+label-based filter plus ownerReference target check to avoid accidental deletion.
Sara Kim (2026-02-19): CI flake on the integration test related to ephemeral namespaces; added retries. Reply: Priya Nair: Added retry/backoff and a teardown step to the test script.

Ops (2026-02-20): Can we emit a metric/log when cleanup job deletes artifacts for observability? Reply: Priya Nair: Added INFO logs and a Helm notes message suggesting the chart emits events that operators can scrape via cluster logging.
release_notes: Stabilize Helm private chart upgrade/rollback: add values schema validation, make init hook tolerations configurable, add rollback cleanup job to remove leftover init artifacts, fix upgrade hangs on noisy clusters. Backwards compatible: defaults preserve previous behavior.
